lines.text: Writing
Descriptive writing is where the writers use to create pictures, or images, in a
reader's mind by using interesting vocabulary and imagery. Writers also make use
of sounds, repetition and different sentence types to help the reader picture the
scene being described. It is important to make the descriptions as clear as possible
by focusing on specific details of the place that you are describing.
Ask yourself the following questions before you start to write to help you focus on
these details:
What does the place look like?
What sounds do I hear?
What does it feel like?
What time was it, day-time or night-time?
Prepare a mind map to organise your thoughts
